verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents a CLI command, `ultrametric init`, that writes its skill files into the project for Codex and Claude Code. A keyless dry-run probe confirmed it targets both `.agents/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md`, the harness skill directories that load in a new session. The flow takes two steps: an npm global install, then a preview run and a write run of `init`. missing for 10: a true single-command install, a hands-on observation of the actual write and of activation in the next session, explicit documentation that the skill is active in the next session, and a multi-skill collection rather than a single skill.
